question: 72 + 28 - (22 div 2) + 33 times 1 + 19 { of } 1 - 16 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the operations in order: (Bracket), (Of), (Division), (Multiplication), (Addition/Subtraction).

Evaluate terms: (22 ÷ 2) = 11, 33 × 1 = 33, and 19 of 1 = 19.

The expression becomes: 72 + 28 − 11 + 33 + 19 − 16.

Group positive and negative terms: (72 + 28 + 33 + 19) − (11 + 16) = 152 − 27 = 125.

**∴ The correct answer is 125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 72 + 28 − (22 ÷ 2) + 33 × 1 + 19 of 1 − 16

**Formula Used:** BODMAS Rule (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 72 + 28 − 11 + 33 × 1 + 19 of 1 − 16 (Solving Bracket)

⇒ 72 + 28 − 11 + 33 × 1 + 19 − 16 (Solving 'Of' → 19 × 1)

⇒ 72 + 28 − 11 + 33 + 19 − 16 (Solving Multiplication → 33 × 1)

⇒ 100 − 11 + 33 + 19 − 16 (Addition from left)

⇒ 89 + 33 + 19 − 16

⇒ 122 + 19 − 16

⇒ 141 − 16

⇒ 125

**∴ The correct answer is 125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence of operations: Brackets (), Of (Orders/powers), Division (÷), Multiplication (×), Addition (+), and Subtraction (−).

Priority of 'Of'

The 'Of' operation is essentially multiplication but must be performed before division and after brackets.

Left-to-Right Rule

When operations of the same priority level (like Addition and Subtraction or Multiplication and Division) appear, they are solved from left to right.
